title: Algorithm: FIFO Task Queue Dispatcher
subtitle: First-In First-Out Buffer Logic
description: Simulate background job queues across 2 interactive stages!

challenges.title: Stage 1: Enqueue Tasks
challenges.starter_code:
queue = []
# Stage 1: Enqueue
queue.append("Task 1")
queue.append("Task 2")
queue.append("Task 3")
print(queue)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Dequeue Head Task
challenges.description: Pop the oldest item: <hlt>job = queue.pop(0)</hlt>. Print <hlt>job</hlt> and remaining <hlt>queue</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
queue = ["Task 1", "Task 2", "Task 3"]
# Stage 2: Dequeue FIFO (index 0)
job = queue.pop(0)
print(job)
print(queue)
